limitations: This is not a cadastral reconstruction or verified physical city calibration. Four approximate locators have unequal residuals; Bielefeld does not determine sovereignty of its entire province.

Only two listed Hanoverian parents may be subdivided; only source-traced conservative cores move to Prussia. Unresolved surrounding Hanoverian assignments remain provisional, not certified historical Hanover ownership.
Ravensberg's southern portion extends into adjacent State Regions excluded from this sublot. The new Prussian subdivision in STATE_HANNOVER is incomplete, not the whole historical county.
Do not copy the 1710 map's colours as a list of countries. Prussian authority at 1776 is separately corroborated; no 1802/1815 acquisitions, no new independent Minden or Ravensberg country.
No physical locators moved. Existing Osnabruck, Lippe, Schaumburg-Lippe, Munster, Paderborn, all previous twenty RGB and 1081 transferred cells are preserved. Erfurt and Swabia untouched.
Herford civic/abbey boundaries remain unresolved rather than inventing an enlarged one-pixel country. Population allocation conserves each actual source profile; no artificial people are created.
